items.markdown:
**Yes, orange juice can help ease some hangover symptoms, though it is not a complete cure and may irritate a sensitive stomach.** [[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShgEBxCJF1y9ZDYu4l7Rm-p-S_Vqb2G-xkj04WnfPpkH7KnP0oN5toOHBQECugwSl-evIW7mOcyDSVX0bEoHTIQysfywXgxccX0rcLg0uYW26AXza3zGfgiAu6eoGI1k1AUWTRn9c2nrnoXMQQaraEeFeEfJtKkLOuJtfi7AwZBppNcMKlJgkrw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXXMRK1bEzTkbjjvtqr-S1dj5LOmx7Lm3b4K3ro6f9giHrwLhw4v70f_qY9upHOEdxy7XLy9ilylvPIZi5YuhyUBF0vyn4A4k5S8uUMdMc7-mQCXLowsdbDP0jSMR1iCiSQW3i7F1I6z5Wef9TQA5_G3pz2UmAUQdhMjQ)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXXYAmLZNqSqEGM3W0RaMOY-UbK9BPzY8liM4VBwp_0HvKWCPnfl-Bq0Tdtkq07ZcIBJRDKBsBuYpHGeW7zM2iqDvlPnCiTjpiEsNOb3XfLaZ4E00usBHdb9HtuaocGiSpyzexkBo5RWxNZ8oxBbX6mu8BD3A)

While time and plain water are the only things that truly clear alcohol from your system, a glass of 100% orange juice offers several recovery benefits alongside a few drawbacks to keep in mind.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXXMRK1bEzTkbjjvtqr-S1dj5LOmx7Lm3b4K3ro6f9giHrwLhw4v70f_qY9upHOEdxy7XLy9ilylvPIZi5YuhyUBF0vyn4A4k5S8uUMdMc7-mQCXLowsdbDP0jSMR1iCiSQW3i7F1I6z5Wef9TQA5_G3pz2UmAUQdhMjQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXXYAmLZNqSqEGM3W0RaMOY-UbK9BPzY8liM4VBwp_0HvKWCPnfl-Bq0Tdtkq07ZcIBJRDKBsBuYpHGeW7zM2iqDvlPnCiTjpiEsNOb3XfLaZ4E00usBHdb9HtuaocGiSpyzexkBo5RWxNZ8oxBbX6mu8BD3A)

### Why It Helps

- **Replenishes lost fluids and electrolytes.** Alcohol acts as a diuretic, and orange juice provides fluids along with potassium to help restore hydration balance.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXemvisR_Kkq_I4TEZBbq-T9vYN2g3X1bzOoH_Jm8w8LhVZDqOONdx0HMz3KTTVJZkz_zdD9SvcNV27iuO3pbETKaE9tmATH6fzQGTFZEq03V85CMR7dZ8O8Sh3Vlc1Nkh)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXXMRK1bEzTkbjjvtqr-S1dj5LOmx7Lm3b4K3ro6f9giHrwLhw4v70f_qY9upHOEdxy7XLy9ilylvPIZi5YuhyUBF0vyn4A4k5S8uUMdMc7-mQCXLowsdbDP0jSMR1iCiSQW3i7F1I6z5Wef9TQA5_G3pz2UmAUQdhMjQ)
- **Delivers vitamin C and antioxidants.** According to [Healthline](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScwHEIkXXcPxjbtPKhN_M4INveLpKz28Yha61wsDLrCR1KID5CezE3hvHI_3pfku_r4FKfkR4WlacvRNE0gw9bMgMqqgPy9wNe2fV2gi02NXwbbzHqP5nqEH3YgdDiG0_N9pjKOnEeGQW6KCoYhG3ko6hCYc) , vitamin C helps maintain levels of glutathione, an antioxidant your body uses to clear alcohol and reduce inflammation.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScwHEIkXXcPxjbtPKhN_M4INveLpKz28Yha61wsDLrCR1KID5CezE3hvHI_3pfku_r4FKfkR4WlacvRNE0gw9bMgMqqgPy9wNe2fV2gi02NXwbbzHqP5nqEH3YgdDiG0_N9pjKOnEeGQW6KCoYhG3ko6hCYc)
- **Stabilizes low blood sugar.** Natural fruit sugars give your body a quick energy boost to fight off hangover fatigue and shakiness, though [Chemist4U](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXXMRK1bEzTkbjjvtqr-S1dj5LOmx7Lm3b4K3ro6f9giHrwLhw4v70f_qY9upHOEdxy7XLy9ilylvPIZi5YuhyUBF0vyn4A4k5S8uUMdMc7-mQCXLowsdbDP0jSMR1iCiSQW3i7F1I6z5Wef9TQA5_G3pz2UmAUQdhMjQ) advises choosing options without added sugars.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXXg1Y6nAztOPoJ0J93tVq8hwHzgnpynuhCP6YQNpQZWSFH4V_6nwFUHeSgcJpIy96z_jomzQYntBa0ydioG-LA2KhvOXicnpWby44Enn7grhtN3DIGSyabqdoL2njNvuxaawPtEd03jdllSxjyKoZFbfuwwg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXXMRK1bEzTkbjjvtqr-S1dj5LOmx7Lm3b4K3ro6f9giHrwLhw4v70f_qY9upHOEdxy7XLy9ilylvPIZi5YuhyUBF0vyn4A4k5S8uUMdMc7-mQCXLowsdbDP0jSMR1iCiSQW3i7F1I6z5Wef9TQA5_G3pz2UmAUQdhMjQ)

### When to Skip It

- **High acidity can worsen nausea.** If your stomach is already upset or you have acid reflux, citrus juice can trigger irritation.
- **Chugging large amounts backfires.** Despite viral social media trends recommending drinking half a carton at once, flooding an empty stomach with sugar and acid can lead to stomach cramps and a sharp blood sugar crash.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShgEBxCJF1y9ZDYu4l7Rm-p-S_Vqb2G-xkj04WnfPpkH7KnP0oN5toOHBQECugwSl-evIW7mOcyDSVX0bEoHTIQysfywXgxccX0rcLg0uYW26AXza3zGfgiAu6eoGI1k1AUWTRn9c2nrnoXMQQaraEeFeEfJtKkLOuJtfi7AwZBppNcMKlJgkrw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXXg1Y6nAztOPoJ0J93tVq8hwHzgnpynuhCP6YQNpQZWSFH4V_6nwFUHeSgcJpIy96z_jomzQYntBa0ydioG-LA2KhvOXicnpWby44Enn7grhtN3DIGSyabqdoL2njNvuxaawPtEd03jdllSxjyKoZFbfuwwg)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeQHEIkXXSo6wwKlvF6SdNRITk6u21YtuC72rmEK9unf_5_uUrci_2jRbLbrSPX5cVLkpUxWZJxy_6Q7uLVeZapPFBB6vM1yaO2RZBMVjYaJTYHwjxfQbHMsi7xdRPv2BM-gCu72QELlgWZg-EE75DmmnG3mK14zx1qw)

### Better Ways to Drink It
If your stomach feels settled enough for juice, stick to **one small glass (4 to 8 ounces)** alongside plain water and bland, easy-to-digest food like toast or eggs. If you feel nauseous, skip the citrus and reach for plain water, coconut water, or ginger tea instead.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShgEBxCJF1y9ZDYu4l7Rm-p-S_Vqb2G-xkj04WnfPpkH7KnP0oN5toOHBQECugwSl-evIW7mOcyDSVX0bEoHTIQysfywXgxccX0rcLg0uYW26AXza3zGfgiAu6eoGI1k1AUWTRn9c2nrnoXMQQaraEeFeEfJtKkLOuJtfi7AwZBppNcMKlJgkrw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXXg1Y6nAztOPoJ0J93tVq8hwHzgnpynuhCP6YQNpQZWSFH4V_6nwFUHeSgcJpIy96z_jomzQYntBa0ydioG-LA2KhvOXicnpWby44Enn7grhtN3DIGSyabqdoL2njNvuxaawPtEd03jdllSxjyKoZFbfuwwg)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXXMRK1bEzTkbjjvtqr-S1dj5LOmx7Lm3b4K3ro6f9giHrwLhw4v70f_qY9upHOEdxy7XLy9ilylvPIZi5YuhyUBF0vyn4A4k5S8uUMdMc7-mQCXLowsdbDP0jSMR1iCiSQW3i7F1I6z5Wef9TQA5_G3pz2UmAUQdhMjQ)Are you dealing with specific symptoms right now (like **nausea** , a **headache** , or **fatigue** ) so I can suggest targeted food and drink options to help?
